svg.title: Qualified zero-covariance effect-difference diagnostic
svg.desc: Page 1 shows 21 of all41 existing estimated discovery/external-outcome pairs. Dots are external minus discovery rg; bars use the unverified Cov=0 standard error. The sleep GWAS is reused. No covariance-adjusted inference or confirmed heterogeneity is supported. Exact pair values and qualifications are in the linked41-row TSV.

g.text: Unverified Cov=0 diagnostic; the same sleep GWAS is reused
All 41 estimated locked pairs retained. Shared sampling covariance is unestimated; these intervals cannot establish heterogeneity.
Table: shared_sleep_cov0_diagnostic41_v4_1.tsv | No new test family, primary claim or fully independent two-trait replication.
